summary.business_type: Hostel / Hospitality — hybrid local + international traveler audience
top_findings: 8 of 8 blog posts serve an empty JS shell in production due to an .htaccess routing bug, confirmed invisible to Google via live URL Inspection API ("URL is unknown to Google")
A legacy WordPress blog URL that was ranking at position 7.9-10.5 (859 impressions/90 days) now 404s with no redirect — organic traffic dropped to zero the week Google's crawl fell out of the index
deploy.sh has a basename-collision bug that could silently overwrite the homepage on next full deploy
2 of 7 pre-rendered static blog files are corrupted (truncated mid-head, invalid JSON escapes)
3 of 8 blog posts are near-duplicate content cannibalizing the same 'Assi Ghat' keyword cluster, with zero functional internal links anywhere on the blog
aggregateRating (4.9/60 reviews) has zero visible on-page reviews backing it — a real Google structured-data policy risk; git history shows a review section built and deleted 6 times
mosaichostels.com ranks #10 of 10 for its own branded name search, behind OTA/review platforms
quick_wins: Fix unsized footer sitewide — eliminates Blog/Mobile's POOR CLS (0.443) in one CSS/HTML change
Add <link rel=preconnect> for Google Fonts — recovers up to ~1,980ms of render-blocking time
Hyperlink existing unlinked booking CTA text inside blog posts — no new copy needed
Verify mosaichostels.com in Bing Webmaster Tools — free, ~10 minutes, unlocks real backlink data
301-redirect the legacy WordPress blog URL — reclaims already-earned ranking position 7.9-10.5

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Core marketing pages clean, static, correctly canonicalized
robots.txt exemplary — explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot
HSTS with preload, correct HTTP->HTTPS and non-www->www redirects, no redirect chains
Mobile viewport correctly configured on every page

findings.title: Sitemap omits all 8 blog URLs with no fallback discovery path
findings.description: sitemap.xml valid but lists only 7 top-level pages; raw HTML of /blog contains zero <a href> links to posts
findings.recommendation: Fix routing/content first (see T-2/T-3), then add all 8 URLs with lastmod dates

findings.title: .htaccess RewriteCond scoping bug shadows real static blog pages
findings.description: RewriteCond only binds to the single next RewriteRule; blog-slug rule fires unconditionally, serving an empty JS shell with blank canonical for all 8 posts and soft-404s for any nonexistent slug
findings.recommendation: Add RewriteCond !-d guard to the blog-slug rule specifically

findings.title: 2 of 7 pre-rendered static blog files are corrupted
findings.description: hostel-near-assi-ghat-varanasi and backpackers-guide-assi-ghat-varanasi truncate mid-<head>, currently masked by the .htaccess bug
findings.recommendation: Regenerate from source markdown before or in the same deploy as the .htaccess fix

findings.title: 9th blog post has no static page, sitemap, or llms.txt entry
findings.description: things-to-do-varanasi-local-guide.md exists but no blog/things-to-do-varanasi-local-guide/ directory exists
findings.recommendation: Build the static page matching the other 7 posts' pattern

findings.title: IndexNow integration non-functional
findings.description: .indexnow-key and IndexNow.xml contain different keys; neither published in spec-required <key>.txt format
findings.recommendation: Pick one key, publish as literal <key>.txt at site root

findings.title: CSP is a single upgrade-insecure-requests directive
findings.description: No real script-src/style-src restrictions despite loading a third-party markdown parser via innerHTML
findings.recommendation: Expand CSP to restrict known asset origins

findings.title: .html and trailing-slash URL variants return 200 with no 301
findings.description: Canonical tags mitigate but don't structurally prevent duplicate crawling
findings.recommendation: Add explicit 301 redirects to clean URLs

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog topics are well-chosen for the dual local+traveler audience
best-hostels-in-varanasi.md clears the word-count floor and has a genuine FAQ section
Honest, non-salesy tone throughout

findings.title: Every blog post serves a contentless shell on first byte in production
findings.description: Confirmed live: identical generic title/description/blank canonical across all 8 posts before JS runs
findings.recommendation: Same fix as Technical T-2/T-3 — serve the existing static pages

findings.title: 3 of 8 posts orphaned from the visible blog index with no internal-link path
findings.description: getAllBlogsMetadata() hardcodes only 5 of 8 posts
findings.recommendation: Fix the metadata function to include all posts

findings.title: Zero hyperlinks in any of the 8 source markdown files
findings.description: No internal links, no links to /book-now, no outbound citations to named sources
findings.recommendation: Convert all Read Next/Further Reading text into real markdown links

findings.title: Heavy near-duplicate content across 5 of 8 posts
findings.description: assi-ghat-varanasi-complete-guide, why-assi-ghat-perfect-base, hostel-near-assi-ghat-varanasi share verbatim paragraphs — textbook keyword cannibalization
findings.recommendation: Merge into one authoritative post, 301-redirect the rest

findings.title: 7 of 8 posts are thin relative to target queries
findings.description: Word counts 29-62% below a reasonable floor; solo-female-safety guide particularly thin vs. 2000-3500 word competing content
findings.recommendation: Expand highest-value posts with specificity, named sources, first-hand signals

findings.title: No first-hand experience signals; generic organizational byline
findings.description: All posts credited to 'Mosaic Hostel Team' with no named author, photo, or credentials
findings.recommendation: Add a named author with bio linked to About page

findings.title: Meta description pollution and broken title escaping
findings.description: Raw 'Published:/Author:' frontmatter leaks into meta descriptions; literal \' artifacts in titles
findings.recommendation: Fix the excerpt generator to strip frontmatter before truncating

categories.name: On-Page SEO / SXO
what_works: Blog posts correctly typed as Blog Posts with proper heading structure
/contact correctly typed as a Local Page with map embed
Clean, human-readable hyphenated URL slugs throughout

findings.title: mosaichostels.com ranks #10 of 10 for its own branded name search
findings.description: Behind LateRooms, trip.com, Hotels.com, Booking.com, Hostelworld, Orbitz, TripAdvisor and Booking reviews
findings.recommendation: Recommend /seo local for a Google Business Profile audit — likely the biggest lever

findings.title: Booking CTA copy exists in blog posts but isn't hyperlinked
findings.description: 'Book your stay at Mosaic today' is plain text with no <a> tag in multiple posts
findings.recommendation: Wrap existing CTA text in links — zero new copy needed

findings.title: Homepage's real value-prop H1 is visually hidden off-screen
findings.description: Visible hero copy is abstract branding only ('Where Culture Meets Comfort'); the keyword-rich H1 is screen-reader-only
findings.recommendation: Promote real value-prop copy into visible hero text

findings.title: WhatsApp CTA sits below the mobile fold on /book-now
findings.description: Primary conversion button starts at y=877px on an 812px viewport
findings.recommendation: Tighten vertical spacing or add a sticky mobile CTA bar

findings.title: /book-now has no map/directions/visible price/reviews
findings.description: Local-intent searchers need map+directions+reviews together; these are split across /book-now and /contact
findings.recommendation: Add a Get Directions link and price/review anchor to /book-now

findings.title: Mobile touch targets undersized
findings.description: Nav 'Book Now' pill (~103x31px) and hamburger (~42x34.5px) below the 44px guideline
findings.recommendation: Increase vertical padding to reach 44px minimum

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Correct Hostel (LodgingBusiness subtype) schema present on every key page, not just one
5-decimal geo coordinate precision, comprehensive amenityFeature list
Correctly recognizes FAQPage retirement — does not recommend adding new FAQ schema for SERP benefit

findings.title: Invalid JSON-LD on blog/index.html
findings.description: Missing comma breaks JSON.parse entirely; file can be served instead of blog.html on trailing-slash requests
findings.recommendation: Delete the stale file or fix the syntax error

findings.title: datePublished contradicts visible content on 2 posts
findings.description: Two posts show a schema date ~2.5 months off from their own markdown source
findings.recommendation: Correct to the markdown frontmatter dates

findings.title: aggregateRating not backed by any visible on-page reviews
findings.description: Every page asserts 4.9/60 reviews with no visible testimonials anywhere — a real Google policy risk
findings.recommendation: Add a genuine visible reviews section or remove the schema from pages without one

findings.title: Missing publisher, mainEntityOfPage, dateModified on 7 static BlogPosting blocks
findings.description: Client-rendered template for the 8th post has these properties; the 7 static ones don't
findings.recommendation: Apply the corrected BlogPosting template from findings/schema.md §6.4

findings.title: Homepage Hostel schema out of sync with other pages
findings.description: Missing @id, checkinTime/checkoutTime, and 2 of 9 sameAs links
findings.recommendation: Sync to the complete version used on book-now/gallery/contact

findings.title: No WebSite schema anywhere
findings.description: Missed opportunity for entity graph consistency
findings.recommendation: Add once to the homepage

findings.title: Organization.logo points to a room photo instead of the brand logo
findings.description: Uses IMG_1928.JPG instead of the existing mosaic-logo-main.png asset
findings.recommendation: Point logo field at the real logo file

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Server response time (TTFB) is fast — Hostinger/LiteSpeed performing well
font-display: swap already correctly applied, no FOIT risk
Modern WebP+JPEG image format delivery on the homepage
Third-party scripts (Microsoft Clarity) loaded correctly via async pattern

findings.title: Blog/Mobile CLS = 0.443 (POOR)
findings.description: Unsized footer logo shifts the whole page after client-side blog card injection
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width/height attributes matching the nav logo's pattern

findings.title: Home/Mobile LCP = 6.3s (POOR)
findings.description: Render-blocking Google Fonts chain (no preconnect) plus a competing 2.6MB hero video
findings.recommendation: Add preconnect hints or self-host fonts; defer/compress the hero video

findings.title: Render-blocking font chain flagged on every page/device
findings.description: 300-1980ms estimated savings available
findings.recommendation: Add rel=preconnect for fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com

findings.title: Several images served 4-5x their display resolution
findings.description: One OTA logo served at 14,583x3,217px displayed at 180x40px
findings.recommendation: Re-export images at true display size

findings.title: PageSpeed/CrUX field data unavailable this cycle
findings.description: API key was missing when this audit ran (now restored); results are lab-only Lighthouse data
findings.recommendation: Re-run PSI/CrUX now that the key is configured for authoritative field data

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot
Existing FAQ content in blog posts is already in ideal AI-extraction format, once reachable
CCBot-blocking-only strategy is defensible and low-risk given live-citation bots are allowed

findings.title: .htaccess bug hides all 8 blog posts from every non-JS AI crawler
findings.description: GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/OAI-SearchBot receive an empty shell despite being explicitly welcomed in robots.txt
findings.recommendation: Same fix as Technical T-2 — this single fix would likely move the GEO score from ~42 to the 70s

findings.title: Blog index has zero server-rendered links to posts
findings.description: Even after the routing fix, crawlers need a discoverable path from /blog to each post
findings.recommendation: Hard-code <a href> cards in the raw HTML, layer JS enhancement on top

findings.title: No FAQPage schema despite FAQ-shaped content already existing
findings.description: Hand-written Q&A content in static pages has no structured markup
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage JSON-LD mirroring the visible FAQ text exactly

findings.title: Zero presence on YouTube or Reddit
findings.description: The two channels most strongly correlated with AI citation (YouTube ~0.737) are entirely absent
findings.recommendation: Publish 2-3 short videos; engage authentically in relevant travel subreddits

findings.title: llms.txt incomplete and will keep drifting
findings.description: Lists only 6 of 8 posts, manually maintained with no generation script
findings.recommendation: Generate from the same source of truth as sitemap/blog listing

categories.name: Images
what_works: Homepage uses <picture><source webp> with JPEG fallback correctly
No horizontal scroll or overflow at any tested viewport

findings.title: Footer logo and OTA badge images drastically oversized
findings.description: Footer logo served at 500x500px PNG displayed at 110x110px; one OTA badge served at 14,583x3,217px
findings.recommendation: Re-export at true display size in WebP/AVIF

findings.title: No responsive srcset on room photos
findings.description: Several images served at 4-5x display resolution, wasting 400-830KB per page on mobile
findings.recommendation: Add srcset with appropriately-sized variants

findings.title: No ImageGallery/ImageObject schema on /gallery
findings.description: 21 photos across 4 categories with no accompanying structured data
findings.recommendation: Add a representative sample of ImageObject entries

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes (sequence matters)
items: Confirm intent and resolve about.html/global.css deletion from working tree
Fix deploy.sh basename-collision bug before next full deploy
Fix .htaccess RewriteCond scoping bug for the blog-slug rule
Regenerate 2 corrupted static blog files
Build the missing 9th static blog page
Fix getAllBlogsMetadata() to include all 8-9 posts
Deploy and verify via raw curl that real content is served
Add all blog URLs to sitemap.xml with lastmod dates
301-redirect the legacy WordPress blog URL to reclaim lost ranking equity
Fix or delete blog/index.html's invalid JSON-LD
Resolve the aggregateRating visible-reviews policy risk
Fix IndexNow key mismatch and publish proper verification file

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Consolidate 3 near-duplicate Assi Ghat posts with 301 redirects
Convert all Read Next/Further Reading text into real hyperlinks; link every post to /book-now
Hyperlink existing unlinked booking CTA copy inside blog posts
Fix the unsized footer image sitewide to eliminate CLS risk
Add font preconnect hints or self-host fonts
Promote the real value-prop H1 into visible hero copy
Move WhatsApp CTA above the mobile fold on /book-now
Add FAQPage schema to posts with existing FAQ content
Fix the meta-description generator's frontmatter-leak bug
Add missing BlogPosting schema properties; correct 2 wrong dates
Verify mosaichostels.com in Bing Webmaster Tools
Add visible price + review-count anchor to /book-now and homepage
Add Get Directions link + map thumbnail to /book-now

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Build out the 3-pillar content architecture (Where to Stay / Things to Do / Safety)
Fill confirmed keyword gaps: seasonal timing, itineraries, transportation, budget breakdown, general safety, local/walk-in audience content
Pursue third-party citation/backlink outreach using existing blog content as bait
Add named authorship with bio to blog posts
Sync homepage Hostel schema; add WebSite schema; fix Organization logo
Get a real JustDial listing
Begin building YouTube/Reddit presence

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-run PSI/CrUX for real field data now that the API key is restored
Monthly manual re-verification of the 4.9-star/60-review figure against live dashboards
Watch GSC for indexation recovery on all 8-9 posts post-fix
Run /seo drift baseline to capture a snapshot for future comparison
Verify GBP primary category directly in the Google Business Profile dashboard
